title: vRT protocol v1: shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by every message schema. See spec/protocol.md for the normative semantics.

identifier.description: An opaque, non-empty identifier. Receivers compare identifiers byte for byte and never parse them.

epoch.description: The interrupt epoch a message belongs to (protocol.md §6).

json.description: Any JSON value, including null. The member itself must be present.

transientEnvelope.description: Envelope of a per-connection message: never resent, never deduplicated, always seq 0 (protocol.md §4.1).

sequencedEnvelope.description: Envelope of a message in the resumable stream: seq starts at 1 and increases by one per message (protocol.md §4.1).

sessionlessEnvelope.description: Envelope of a sequenced message that may also be sent with seq 0 before a session exists (protocol.md §4.1).

capability.description: A capability token (protocol.md §3.3). Lowercase ASCII words separated by '.' or '-'; tokens starting with 'x-' are reserved for private experiments.

audioFormat.description: An audio encoding (protocol.md §8.2). sampleRate applies to pcm16; it defaults to 24000 when absent.

toolSpec.description: A tool the client hosts. parameters is a JSON Schema object describing the arguments, as the model sees it.

failureCode.description: Why a tool call did not succeed (protocol.md §7.3).

errorCode.description: An error code (protocol.md §9.2). Upper-case ASCII words separated by '_'. The set is open: receivers act on `recoverable` for codes they do not know.
